##### Project general facts

The Palm Tower is an iconic landmark rising 240 metres above the heart of Palm Jumeirah, offering a collection of elegant residences within a prestigious 52-storey mixed-use development. The project combines sophisticated architecture with luxury living, featuring 432 stylish apartments alongside the renowned St. Regis Dubai – The Palm hotel. Inspired by the shape of a palm tree, the tower stands as one of Dubai’s most exclusive addresses, delivering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and the city skyline.

Residents enjoy access to world-class amenities that elevate the living experience to new heights. The tower is home to the famous AURA Skypool and Lounge, one of the world’s highest infinity pools, as well as the internationally acclaimed SUSHISAMBA restaurant. The View at The Palm observation deck offers panoramic vistas, while the integrated hotel services provide a seamless lifestyle with premium hospitality, leisure, and wellness facilities.

The residences are designed with meticulous attention to detail, featuring elegant interiors finished in a neutral colour palette complemented by luxury flooring and high-quality fixtures. Each home reflects sophistication and comfort, with fully equipped kitchens and premium appliances. The apartments are offered fully furnished, creating a refined and ready-to-move-in living environment.


##### Location description and benefits

Palm Jumeirah offers a range of world-class amenities and attractions. One of the most famous landmarks is the Atlantis, The Palm, a five-star resort located at the apex of the palm tree. It features an Aquaventure Waterpark, The Lost Chambers Aquarium, and a variety of luxury accommodations and dining options.

Palm Jumeirah is also home to a vibrant marina, where residents and visitors can enjoy yachting, boating, and other water activities. The crescent-shaped breakwater is lined with luxury hotels, resorts, and beach clubs that offer stunning views of the Dubai skyline.

Transportation on the island is facilitated by monorail, which connects Palm Jumeirah to the mainland, providing easy access to other parts of Dubai. The island is also well-connected by road networks and offers ample parking spaces for residents and guests.
